hosts_allow.description: List of access control rules granting permission in /etc/hosts.allow. Each item is a flat map of daemon, client, and optional option fields. Use '*' for all daemons/services. Use 'ALL' for all clients/hosts. Use 'EXCEPT' keyword within client string to exclude specific hosts from a wildcard match. Options include commands to run on connection (e.g., 'spawn echo %h >> /var/log/tcpd.log'). See hosts_access(5) for syntax details.

hosts_deny.description: List of access control rules denying permission in /etc/hosts.deny. Same structure as hosts_allow. Default is to deny all services from all hosts to enforce a whitelist-only policy.
